title: Technician - E. Complete an inspection (Submit and Generate Report)
preconds: Logged in as Technician. Tech View. Per SV-8095 AC4, View Mode is NOT a gate for inspections. An inspection is in progress with required fields fillable.
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open an in-progress inspection.
  3. Fill all required fields.
  4. Click Submit and Generate Report.
expected:
Step 3: With no required field outstanding, Submit and Generate Report is visible and clickable - even on an approved line (SV-8095 AC4: not gated by Tech View).
Step 4: The inspection is submitted, a report is generated, and status becomes "Completed".
